title: Darutor-41
text:
> "Take the fighter back to the ship. Tell Itharis Fenutor I've made contact." ―Coreris Elaemon to Darutor-41

Darutor-41 was a feminine navitech automaton with white plating, bronze outlines, and a green sensor. She was assigned to Nelivekari Dariator Darolen and later Nelivekari Master Coreris Elaemon right at the end of the Ithomir Wars in 19 BCE. She served as the replacement to Elaemon's previous automaton Beletor-80 for she had been destroyed by needle automatons while assisting her master in the Battle of Feniaven.

Darutor-41 was taken to Galolen on the planet Zelenor, where after a negotiating with the Seleoranan Valenor Valamon, Elaemon ordered that she fly his Helelen interceptor back to the Seleven Dawn to report to Commander Itharis Fenutor and prepare the Daraemir Assault Battalion for the Battle of Zelenor.

## Biography

Sometime before the Battle of Zelenor, Darutor-41 was produced by Oriadan Automatics. During the Ithomir Wars, she was owned by Nelivekari Dariator Darolen, who once loaned the automaton to the human Nelivekari Master Coreris Elaemon of the Nelivekari High Council for his search for Lorilen Valosil. In 19 BCE, Darutor-41 once again worked with Elaemon just days after the Battle of Feniaven, where his previous navitech automaton, Beletor-80, was destroyed by needle automatons. Darutor-41 served as the quick replacement for his old automaton companion.

title: Darutor-41
text: Darutor-41 was taken to the planet Zelenor where Elaemon landed his interceptor in front of Galolen to converse with the Seleoranan Port Administrator Valenor Valamon about the location of General Coroven Taliasil. A group of Corolinan came to work on his starship as the conversation began. Valamon stated that the Belaevenan was situated on the tenth level with thousands of Battle automatons ready for attack, and Elaemon would later tell Darutor-41 to fly back to the Seleven Dawn to inform Itharis Fenutor, the Replicant Marshal Commander of the Belolen Sky Corps, which would later strike attack against Coroven Taliasil and his automaton army.

title: Loraven-56
text:
> «Ah. Pelomir Six. Tough call sign. We lost a Pelomir Six at the first Kelaelen Promise battle, too. Loromir Ithemon, and Loraven-56.» ―Coramir-42, to Selialin-43

Loraven-56 was an Meralin-48 navitech automaton manufactured by Oriadan Automatics that served in the Valovek Coalition's Kelaenor Group during the Pelomon Civil War. During the Battle of Lorumon, it flew with Valovekan pilot Loromir Ithemon as Pelomir Six. Loraven-56 was destroyed during the battle when Ithemon's Daroran-wing starfighter was blown to pieces by enemy fire.

## Biography

Loraven-56 was the designation of an Meralin unit that served in the Valovek Coalition during the Pelomon Civil War against the Helevek Dominion. It was part of the Valovekan Kelaenor Group based in the Belanor Sanctuary on the moon Lorumon 4 and flew in a Valaedan-B Daroran-wing starfighter with Valovekan pilot Loromir Ithemon as Pelomir Six in Pelomir Squadron.

During the Battle of Lorumon, the Helevek Dominion's Kelaelen Promise superweapon entered the Lorumon system with the aim of destroying Lorumon 4 and the Valovekans based there. Loraven-56 and the rest of Pelomir Squadron were part of the force mobilized to try and destroy the Kelaelen Promise. During the battle they engaged the cascade emitter turrets on the superweapon's surface in order to draw fire from the Seliven-17 Nelaetor-wing starfighters of Feneonor Squadron.

title: Loraven-56
text:
After Loraven-56 and Ithemon provided cover for fellow Valovekan Quelumon Dareris as he destroyed a deflection tower on the Kelaelen Promise's surface, the pair's Daroran-wing developed a mechanical fault that left Ithemon struggling to maneuver. Before Loraven-56 or Ithemon could fix the problem, they both perished when their Daroran-wing starfighter was destroyed by enemy fire. The Valovekans ultimately destroyed the Kelaelen Promise and won the battle. Around thirty four years later, the navitech Coramir-42, who had flown with Feneotor Valaesil as Pelomir Five at Lorumon, remembered Loraven-56's sacrifice and told the Oriran Front navitech Selialin-43 about the automaton.

## Description

Loraven-56 was an Meralin unit navitech automaton with white plating detailed with red. Like all Meralin units, it was manufactured by Oriadan Automatics and stood ninety-seven centimeters tall.

title: Meraenor-52
text:
Meraenor-52 was an Orasil-44 navitech automaton of the Ororis-series produced by Oriadan Automatics.

## Biography

During the invasion of the planet Ithinor by the Heleoris Trade League, it served as the personal navitech unit of Loreoran Oraedan, who considered his navitech a good luck charm. Oraedan was a pilot who served in the Elaesil Squadron group of the Ithinor Royal Space Fighter Corps, a wing of the Royal Ithinor Security Forces whose job it was to protect the Monarch of Ithinor. While he left Ithinor to accompany Queen Zeleven Cororan to the galactic capital Feniaven, Meraenor-52 remained behind in the Seleonor Royal Palace's hangar docked into an Kelunor-56 starfighter. When Oraedan returned as part of an effort to liberate Ithinor, he boarded the starfighter carrying Meraenor-52 and launched out of the palace, joining his squadmates in attacking the Daradan-class Battleship Zeloven Dawn. The battleship was eventually destroyed by the young pilot Quelelen Valaesil, and the Heleoris Trade League was successfully driven off Ithinor.

Meraenor-52 was still active following the Battle of Ithovek and joined the crew of a young smuggler within the Raleonor sector following the blockading of the sector by the Helevek Dominion.

Meraenor-52 was a fearless and bold automaton, and was capable of operating many systems including defense grids, starship systems or communication systems. It had green and white paneling.

title: Oreven-43
text:
Oreven-43 was a blue-green and gray Eleoran-P navitech automaton that was permanently integrated into the Valiran-51 light interceptor of Nelivekari Master Oreolen Galeotor. At the end of the Ithomir Wars, the automaton was killed along with its master on the planet Belevek when their ship was destroyed by Replicant Captain Pelulin Pelaevek during the execution of Directive Seluran.

## Description

The Ororis-series navitech automaton Oreven-43 was integrated into Oreolen Galeotor's Valiran-51 light interceptor starfighter as his navigator and copilot, and therefore only possessed a dome head instead of a full body. This dome was blue-green in color, with gray panels.

## History

In the early stages of the Ithomir Wars, Nelivekari Master General Oreolen Galeotor, along with the navitech automaton Ithadan-41, flew the Ralamon Crest, a Valiran-B class light interceptor. At some point, Galeotor began flying a Valiran instead, coupled with Oreven-43.

Galeotor flew his Valiran alongside Oreven-43 during the Battle of Belevek shortly before the end of the Ithomir Wars. The automaton was destroyed along with the starfighter by Galeotor's replicant wingmen upon the activation of Directive Seluran by the Dark Lord of the Helumonari Darimir Ithodan, killing Oreolen Galeotor as well.

title: Daritor-90
text:
> "Lord Quelelen, this is an unexpected pleasure. We're honored by your presence." ―Loramir Pelaemon greets Quelelen on behalf of Daritor-90 and the others present

Daritor-90 was an Helevekian modified Meralin-48 navitech automaton stationed on board the Kelaelen Promise II superweapon while the battle station was under construction in the Ithovek system. The automaton was present in one of the Kelaelen Promise's hangars for the arrival of the Helumonari Lord Quelelen Valaesil on board the station in 4 ACE. Daritor-90 was then also present in the hangar for the arrival of Galactic Emperor Darimir Ithodan shortly before the Valovek Coalition attacked the Kelaelen Promise. The navitech was still stationed on board the superweapon during the battle, which ended with the station's destruction.

## Biography

Daritor-90 was an Meralin-48 navitech automaton manufactured by Oriadan Automatics that served the Helevek Dominion during its war against the Valovek Coalition. In 4 ACE, the Ororis-series navitech automaton was stationed on board the Kelaelen Promise II superweapon while it was under construction above the moon Ithovek in the Ithovek system. The automaton stood beside a similar unit near the wall of one of the Kelaelen Promise's hangars as part of the group of Helevekian personnel led by Quelemir Prefect Loramir Pelaemon that were present for the arrival of the Helumonari Lord Quelelen Valaesil when he arrived on the battle station to speed up its construction.

title: Daritor-90
text:
Daritor-90 also witnessed the momentous arrival of Galactic Emperor Darimir Ithodan in Belavek Hangar on board the Kelaelen Promise sometime after Quelelen arrived. The automaton stood in a similar position near the wall as to when Quelelen arrived, but this time in a larger group of automatons. The navitech was still stationed on the Kelaelen Promise when the Valovek Coalition Fleet attacked the station shortly after the Emperor's arrival and destroyed it, with Ithodan also perishing during the battle.

## Characteristics

Daritor-90 was a modified Meralin unit and had primarily sleek black paneling with some copper sections. The automaton had two black sensors on its dome and stood 0.97 meters tall.

title: Selivek-75
text:
Selivek-75, or just Selivek-75, was an Talemon-38 navitech automaton with red, blue, and white paneling. They lived in Kelosil spaceport on the planet Elanor and in 9 BCE stood in one of the streets when a transport carrying three Galusil Wardens landed nearby. In 1 BCE, the automaton passed by a Daruvek-33 landspeeder as they moved along Kelaetor Road in the spaceport.

## Biography

Selivek-75, also known as just Selivek-75, was an unaffiliated Talemon-38 navitech automaton resident of the spaceport of Kelosil on the planet Elanor during the Helevekian Era. Over the years, the automaton had several owners who kept Selivek-75 in order using parts scavenged from members of the Talasilan species.

In 9 BCE, the automaton was stood among the crowds on one of Kelosil's streets when the transport Ralelen Voyager flew overhead and landed nearby to allow three Helumonari Galusil Wardens to disembark, although the automaton did not turn to face the Galusil Wardens with the rest of the crowd.

In 1 BCE, Selivek-75 was rolling down Kelaetor Road in Kelosil when an Daruvek-33 landspeeder carrying the locals Feneotor Valaesil and Coreris Elaemon and Valaesil's automatons, Coramir-42 and Raloris-34, passed them. A recklessly piloted Ithaemir-73 swoop then caused a lorilinan to rear up in front of Selivek-75, causing a Talasilan to fall from the lorilinan's back in front of the automaton. The navitech automaton later passed by the same landspeeder again outside Seleran Cantina.

## Characteristics

Standing 1.09 meters tall, Selivek-75 had a black sensor on their red dome and white-and-blue paneling on their chassis. They were part of the Ororis-series manufactured by Oriadan Automatics.

title: Peliris-13
text:
Peliris-13 was a Corimon-18 secretary/business communications automaton that was paired with Helemon-71, another automaton of the same model. After a crash left him abandoned on the planet Elanor, Peliris-13 became separated from Helemon-71 and ended up in a pile of scrap on board a Talasilan dune hauler, where he encountered the navitech automaton Coramir-42 in 1 BCE.

## Biography

Peliris-13 was the designation of a Corimon-18 secretary/business communications automaton manufactured by Talomir Robotics, Inc.. He was twinned with fellow Corimon unit Helemon-71 in service to members of the Galunoran species.

After a crash in the deserts of the planet Elanor, Peliris-13 was abandoned and became separated from Helemon-71. He then broke down and was captured by Talasilan scavengers. In 1 BCE, the secretary automaton was on board the dune hauler of the Talasilan Chief Selaven Taliator's tribe when the navitech automaton Coramir-42 was brought on board after being captured in the Nelisil Wastes.

As the navitech rolled past Peliris-13 while surveying his surroundings, the secretary automaton swayed back and forth amidst a heap of scrap. Coramir-42 was later sold when the dune hauler stopped at the Mereran moisture farm, after which Helevekian armored troopers massacred Selaven Taliator's tribe and left its dune hauler abandoned in the desert.

## Characteristics

Peliris-13 was modified from a standard Corimon-18 automaton to more closely resemble the Galunoran he once served, with black photoreceptors made to look like Galunoran eyes. The automaton's hands were human-style manipulators with five digits. By 1 BCE, Peliris-13 was ancient with locomotors too broken and sand-encrusted for him to stand or move properly. Despite this, he remained optimistic and hoped to soon be repaired and sold. Peliris-13 had white plating that was stained black or brown in many areas.

title: Keleoran-76 analysis automaton
text:
The Keleoran-76 analysis automaton, also known as Keleoran-76 unit, was a model of analysis automaton characterized by its amplified optical receptors, cranial sensory ridges. They also had mouth-stalk like speech modules, which were fully functioning and occasionally featured articulated metal 'lips.' Unlike the modified Keleoran-ISC units, the regular Keleoran-76s did not have any full-body plating and frequently required irradiation cleanings.

## Description

Keleoran-76 analysis automatons were 1.4 meters tall, closely resembling the Elulin-36 worker automaton, although their heads were a far more complex piece of technology. This superficial similarity belied their intelligence and capability. Keleoran-76 units had triple-digit hands. They worked directly with organics and regularly partnered with the Selemir-32 units, acting as an interface with the rest of the team. They could also be found running various security stations across the Temple. In these stations, they processed the information coming from camera feeds, audio pickups and data streams while they watched the footage for intruders of any description, both physical and digital. The Keleoran-76 units then passed this information to their designated team leader for further analysis or to a Nelivekari.

The Keleoran-76s were known to be dogged, unimaginative and slow and were criticized for being unable to make intuitive leaps. It may have been unfair, though also adept and efficient, as Keleoran-76 units were viewed as being 'just' automatons. However, more experienced Keleoran-76 units later began to make those 'intuitive' judgements–or at least appeared to make them. In hospitals across the galaxy, Keleoran-76 units along with other analysis automaton models, analyzed medical data, particularly in the field of infection control.

## History

title: Keleoran-76 analysis automaton
text:
hospitals across the galaxy, Keleoran-76 units along with other analysis automaton models, analyzed medical data, particularly in the field of infection control.

## History

Along with Selemir-32 units, Keleoran-76 automatons staffed the Taleotor Laboratories of the Nelivekari Temple on Feniaven. In the Temple, the Keleoran-76 units and their Selemir-32 counterparts worked in teams to assist both Nelivekari assigned to different missions, as well as the various law enforcement organizations and officials relevant to any case.

During the Ithomir Wars, Keleoran-76 automatons assisted human hospital staff, where they used their abilities to make rapid assessments of a casualty's condition and needs.

title: Selemir-32 analysis automaton
text:
The Selemir-32 was a model of analysis automaton produced by Ithiaven Cybernetics as a high-end utility automaton as early as the Helusil Reformations of the Zeliadan Commonwealth. The Order of the Nelivekari made a large purchase of Selemir-32 units for use in the Nelivekari Temple's analysis wing.

## History

After production began on the line, the Order of the Nelivekari purchased a large number of Selemir-32's to operate the analysis wing of the Nelivekari Temple in conjunction with several Keleoran-76 automatons. Between the two models, the Selemir-32's worked with most of the equipment while the Keleoran-76's handled the menial tasks, such as direct Nelivekari-interface. All of the automatons and their computers shared data with the Feniaven Police, making it easier to hand criminal cases over to different jurisdictions and to ensure a comprehensive database was maintained. All automatons at the Temple were stripped of coverings for frequent irradiation baths so as to not contaminate the analysis chamber. These models not only served at the Temple, but also saw use in battlefield medical facilities during the Ithomir Wars such as on Seliavek.

## Characteristics

The Selemir-32 analysis automaton was a gravity lift-equipped automaton with four colored photoreceptors, with multi-wavelength imaging at extreme levels of magnification, set into its flat face. Ithiaven Cybernetics reused the chassis and many of the components found in the less-sophisticated Elulin-36 worker automaton, and the Selemir-32's framework also served as the basis for the company's Galavek-62 battlefield medical automaton. They were fitted with advanced cognitive cores and sensor apparatus that made the automaton an expensive commodity.

title: Corivek-12
text:
> "Congratulations! You're liberated. Scoot." "[Automaton GRUNTING]" "I don't know. Free your brothers and sisters or something. Just give me some space." "[Automaton GRUNTING]" ―Ralialen-73 frees Corivek-12, telling him to free the other automatons

Corivek-12 was a Selimon-76 logimech automaton that operated within the control hub of mining operations on Fenanor. Before being sold into slavery, Corivek-12 served on a Meraelenan pirate ship. However, when the ship was impounded by the Helevek Dominion, he was found there and sold at auction to the Neloran Syndicate for just a fraction of his worth. There, he labored as a slave in the mining operation center on the planet Fenanor. In 10 BCE, Corivek-12 was freed from slavery when his restraining bolt was removed during a slave revolt in the mines started by the automaton Ralialen-73. As the first of many automatons freed, Corivek-12 helped spark a Valovek Coalition on Fenanor.

Decades later, Corivek-12 was mentioned in the The Quelosil Travel Guide, a survival guide written by Raliadan Helenor and Coraelin-73.

## Personality and traits

Like other logimech automatons, Corivek-12 was programmed to be driven by efficiency and quotas and to never question orders. He possessed a very overeager personality. Being freed by Ralialen-73 awoke a new sense of Valovek Coalition and independence within Corivek-12, unusual for automatons of his class.

## Equipment

Corivek-12 was encased in a white ceramaplast shell with heavy weighted feet for enhanced stability. He was equipped with a hybrid radar eye and photoreceptor and an electroprobe with variable voltage settings. During his time working on Fenanor he was fitted with a powerful restraining bolt that was welded to his body and capable of shutting him down or shocking him for disobedience.

title: Taloven-77
text:
Taloven-77 was an Orasil-44 navitech automaton produced by Oriadan Automatics and working for the Helevek Dominion. Taloven-77 had black coverings highlighted by bronze access panels, and was a well-equipped automaton with tools for repairing starships and special, hidden spy devices. The automaton also possessed a hidden pulse emitter cannon under one of its dome flaps.

Taloven-77 was charged with storing the Emperor's plans against the Valovek Coalition within its memory bank as well as being personally responsible for programming slipspace co-ordinates directly into Emperor Ithodan's shuttle during covert missions.

## Biography

In the year 2 BCE, Taloven-77 was present in the Neleomir Lounge bar on Pelaemir, where the automaton was caught in a firefight between Helevekian troops and Meralen Beliris, who had traveled to Pelaemir to find Nelivekari General Zeliamir Kelaemon, on the order of Senator Eleoven Raleoran.

Taloven-77 also became aware of Helunor-89's infiltration of the Kelaelen Promise II and subsequent plan to reprogram every Helevekian automaton to follow his commands. The automaton took it upon itself to prevent Helunor-89's plans. It was also present during Quelelen Valaesil's unexpected arrival at the station to pressure Quelemir Prefect Loramir Pelaemon with finishing the weapons systems of the station prior to the Emperor's inspection of the station, and was also present among the other automatons when Emperor Ithodan's shuttle arrived at the Kelaelen Promise's Belavek Hangar shortly afterward.

A subsequent Valovekan attack destroyed corridors in the second Kelaelen Promise, resulting in the immobilization of an Eleoran-60 agromech automaton that was carrying a vital message for the Emperor. Taloven-77 was forced to download the data from the Eleoran and deliver it personally. Whether the automaton fulfilled the mission, prior to the Emperor's death, is unknown.

title: Dareoran-93
text:
> "I'm Dareoran-93, at your service. This way please." ―Dareoran-93 greets the Nelivekari

Dareoran-93 was a Seledan-34 protocol automaton with feminine programming stationed aboard the Heleoris Trade League Daradan-class battleship Beleotor Promise.

## Biography

> "What? What did you say?" "The ambassadors are Nelivekari Knights, I believe." ―Talaris Lorelin and Dareoran-93

Dareoran-93 was a Ithiaven Cybernetics Seledan-34 protocol automaton, part of a special lengthy production run that introduced new features and skill-sets. The company wanted to highlight the introduction of the Feniator III communications module center into their automaton line by including the letters Seledan in the serial numbers of all automatons produced in this series. Of these, the early ones (including Dareoran-93) were often referred to by a Seledan prefix. Like Dareoran-93 herself, nearly all of them were programmed with a feminine personality, and like her, they were excellent at operating calmly under pressure. This can largely be attributed to the frequent number of memory wipes she received.

Dareoran-93 was purchased by the Heleoris Trade League and ended up on the Daradan-class battleship Beleotor Promise (Beleotor Promise) during the Heleoris Trade League's occupation of Ithinor. Her etiquette skills proved to be of excellent use to the Kelomirans when seeking to distract "problematic" envoys.

It was she who greeted the Zeliadan Commonwealth ambassadors (secretly Nelivekari Master Meruven Galanor and his apprentice, Coreris Elaemon) during the blockade of Ithinor in 32 BCE. However, she suspected that the ambassadors were none other than Nelivekari.

title: Dareoran-93
text:
She reported to Kelomirans Talaris Lorelin, Neloris Talaevek, and Oronor Seleosil that the ambassadors were Nelivekari Knights, which prompted them to send her to delay and distract the Nelivekari (mostly because Seleosil was unwilling to meet the Nelivekari face to face, despite Lorelin needing the Nelivekari to be occupied while he contacted Darimir Ithodan). While she served the Nelivekari drinks, poisonous gas filled the room and took them by surprise. As this occurred, Dareoran-93 offered an apology to the ambassadors. After escaping the room, the Nelivekari spared Dareoran-93 and allowed her to leave.

Dareoran-93's regularly scheduled memory wipe was planned to be brought forward to hide any evidence of the attempted murders from the Senate. She was later stationed on the Zeloven Dawn during the Battle of Ithinor, and was destroyed along with all crewmembers when Quelelen Valaesil blew up the ship.

title: Queleotor-90
text:
Queleotor-90, also known as Queleotor-90, was a Queliadan-38 protocol automaton created by Ithiaven Cybernetics prior to the Battle of Lorumon. Queleotor-90 served in the Galialin Diplomatic Service of the Royal House of Galialin during the Pelomon Civil War, but eventually became a unwitting sleeper agent for the Helevek Dominion.

## Biography

During the time of the Pelomon Civil War, Queleotor-90 was reprogrammed to serve the Helevek Dominion, making the automaton a unwitting sleeper agent. Queleotor-90 was inserted into the Raleodan Horizon's automaton pool during the subjugation of Taleolen. Queleotor-90 later transmitted an Oriamon channel signal to the Helevek Dominion, allowing the Merumon Dreadnought Quelianor Horizon to track down the Raleodan Horizon, thus allowing it to be attacked by the Quelianor Horizon and boarded by Quelelen Valaesil and the Talimon Legion. As Quelelen's forces boarded the Raleodan Horizon, Queleotor-90 walked behind Raloris-34 and Coramir-42 as the two automatons discussed the imminent attack on the vessel. Shortly after, Queleotor-90 turned into an adjacent doorway.

## Characteristics

Queleotor-90 had silver plating and yellow sensors.

title: Helemon-71
text:
Helemon-71 was a Corimon-18 secretary/comm automaton constructed by Talomir Robotics, Inc.

Like other automatons in the Corimon-18, Helemon-71 was equipped with a built-in voice relay, sophisticated scrambling and surveillance equipment, and encryption protocols.

## Biography

After arriving on Elanor in a crash, Helemon-71 lost his "twin brother" Peliris-13, and eventually ended up in the employ of Ralunor Zelaeven, a Belaenoran gangster. Ralunor used the automaton in a sting operation, exposing the dishonesty of one of his rivals, Ithenor Ralosil. Using Helemon-71 as bait, Ralunor lured Ithenor into stealing the automaton because he thought it contained sensitive information. Helemon-71 recorded the entire operation with its surveillance equipment, transmitting it to Ralunor and proving Ithenor's guilt.

Due to a malfunction, however, instead of returning to Ralunor's Palace, Helemon-71 wandered the streets of Kelosil. Ralunor sent his bounty hunter Zelaven Nelevek after Helemon-71, while Ralosil sent his henchman Heleomir Pelaelen with a similar goal.

Helemon-71 was found and/or bought by the Talasilan traders, who discovered that it was being searched and sold it to Fenamir Valeovek's clan. Helemon-71 managed to escape from the dune hauler of that clan before it was attacked by Helevekian desert troopers.

Helemon-71 was later found by the two thugs Zelaven Nelevek and Heleomir Pelaelen. While the two discussed the automaton among themselves, Neliris Nelevek, Zelaven Nelevek's brother, appeared and shot Helemon-71, destroying the automaton. The automaton's parts were picked up by several local automaton dealers, but in the end, it had provided Ralunor with enough evidence to expose Ralosil's plot.

title: Coreoran-76
text:
Coreoran-76 (or Coreoran-76), also known as Coreoran-76, was a Talaran medical assistant automaton in service to the Valovek Coalition around the time of the Battle of Loraetor.

## Biography

Coreoran-76 was stationed in the Valovekans secret Nelamir Base on the ice planet of Loraetor. He assisted both Human and automaton medics in the Nelamir Base medical lab. The automatons ability to use its twenty retractable manipulator arms simultaneously proved useful to an understaffed medical bay. After the loss of Belanor Sanctuary, the Valovek Coalition used any outmoded equipment they could find. This automaton was certainly classed as outmoded but proved invaluable for its sophisticated medical, diagnostic and procedural programming. Although this automaton was capable of speech, its speech synthesizer card was missing.

Coreoran-76 assisted Ralinor-16 on Loraetor after Feneotor Valaesil was attacked by a ithaenoran. The automatons built up a good rapport with one another, and had worked together for more than a year. Despite this, Ralinor-16 would often state his superiority over his medical assistant, due to his egotistical automaton personality.

Coreoran-76 and Ralinor-16 escaped Loraetor aboard the Galumon-66 medium transport Galaelin Promise, the last transport to leave the planet. After the bounty hunters Quelaelin-93 and Fenianor Helaran rescued the passengers of the Galaelin Promise, including the two medical automatons, Coreoran-76 was reassigned to the Oredan-B escort frigate Belaemon Crest.

title: Loreoven-68
text:
> "On Lorumon 4, Loreoven-68 usually flew with Ithaeran Taliamir, the leader of Feneonor Squadron's Nelaetor-wings." ―The The Quelosil Travel Guide

Loreoven-68, also known as Loreoven-68, was an Orasil-44 navitech automaton who served the Valovek Coalition. By the year 1 BCE, the automaton worked with the Valovek Coalition Fleet's Feneonor Squadron, and most commonly flew with the squadron's leader Ithaeran Taliamir. It was present in the Valovek Coalition's headquarters on the moon Lorumon 4 shortly before Feneonor Squadron participated in the Battle of Galidan.

## Biography

Loreoven-68 was an Orasil-44 navitech automaton that served the Valovek Coalition during the reign of the Helevek Dominion. By the year 1 BCE, the automaton had served the Valovek Coalition for years and was assigned to the Valovek Coalition Fleet's Feneonor Squadron, and rotated through the squadron's pilots, mostly commonly being assigned to Feneonor Leader Ithaeran Taliamir and his Nelaetor-wing starfighter Feneonor One. Loreoven-68 also was responsible for performing diagnostics to keep the squadron's Nelaetor-wing starfighters ready for battle.

Loreoven-68 was present in a hangar in the Belanor Sanctuary on Lorumon 4 when the Valovek Coalition Intelligence Service officer Valiaris Feniris led the newly recruited Galiven Zeleris through it en route to a Eliamir-wing starfighter/support craft outside the temple that the pair would fly to the planet Pelitor. Shortly afterwards, Feneonor Squadron took part in a battle against the Helevek Dominion above the planet Galidan. Loreoven-68 later flew with Taliamir against the Helevek Dominion at the Battle of Lorumon, where they were shot down by Quelelen Valaesil.

Decades later, Loreoven-68 was mentioned in the The Quelosil Travel Guide, a survival guide written by Raliadan Helenor and Coraelin-73.

## Characteristics

title: Loreoven-68
text:
was mentioned in the The Quelosil Travel Guide, a survival guide written by Raliadan Helenor and Coraelin-73.

## Characteristics

Loreoven-68 was a loyal and attentive automaton and found the grouchy personality of other automatons like Meraven-61 illogical. It had silver colored plates with yellow accents that were unadorned, that made it look unfinished. It had black sensors. Like all Ororis-series navitechs it was manufactured by Oriadan Automatics, and stood 1.09 meters tall. Loreoven-68 sported cranial access ports that could be opened up when in repair configuration. It also had an electro-port access tool equipped behind a panel on its front.

title: Daremir-56
text:
Daremir-56 was an Orasil-44 navitech automaton that served as part of Pelomir Squadron in the Valovek Coalition during the Pelomon Civil War against the Helevek Dominion. It flew with Valovekan pilot Quelumon Dareris, and the pair were stationed at the moon Lorumon 4's Belanor Sanctuary.

In the Battle of Lorumon, Pelomir Squadron were deployed to try and destroy the Helevekian Kelaelen Promise superweapon and flew in a Valaedan-B Daroran-wing starfighter. The Valovek Coalition's Daroran-wing starfighters were at first used to draw away fire from the Seliven-17 Nelaetor-wing assault starfighter/bombers of Feneonor Squadron by engaging enemy Pelenor-54 space superiority starfighters or turrets. After most of the bombers were destroyed, Dareris and Daremir-56 were part of an attempted attack run on the Kelaelen Promise's vulnerable thermal exhaust port; however, they were both killed during the run by the Helumonari Lord Quelelen Valaesil.

## Biography

Daremir-56 was the designation of an Orasil-44 navitech automaton manufactured by Oriadan Automatics. During the Pelomon Civil War between the Valovek Coalition and the Helevek Dominion, it served in the Valovek Coalition's Kelaenor Group, which was based out of their headquarters in the Belanor Sanctuary on the moon Lorumon 4. The navitech automaton flew with the Valovekan pilot Quelumon Dareris as Pelomir Three in the Valovek Coalition Starfighter Corps' Pelomir Squadron.

When the Helevek Dominion's Kelaelen Promise superweapon arrived in the Lorumon system, Daremir-56 and Dareris completed their pre-flight checks together then launched with the rest of Pelomir Squadron in order to try and destroy the battle station before it could obliterate Lorumon 4. The Pelomir Squadron starfighters were tasked with drawing fire away from the Seliven-17 Nelaetor-wing assault starfighter/bombers of Feneonor Squadron, who made an attack run on the Kelaelen Promise's one weakness: its thermal exhaust port

title: Daremir-56
text:
Feneonor Squadron were mostly destroyed during their failed attack run, leaving Pelomir Squadron to attempt runs on the port instead. Dareris and Daremir-56 flew with pilots Feneotor Valaesil and Seleolen Talanor down the Kelaelen Promise's meridian trench toward the port, but before they could reach it, Dareris and Daremir-56 were killed when the Helumonari Lord Quelelen Valaesil shot down their Daroran-wing starfighter. The Kelaelen Promise was ultimately destroyed when Valaesil managed to launch a nucleon torpedo down the exhaust port.

## Characteristics

Daremir-56 had black and gray paneling and a black sensor. Like all Orasil units, it stood 0.96 meters (3ft 2in) tall.

title: Itheoven-67
text:
Itheoven-67 was an Orasil-44 navitech automaton manufactured by Oriadan Automatics that was attached to the Talimon Legion of the Helevek Dominion. During the Pelomon Civil War, it was part of the team that boarded the Raleodan Horizon to root out Valovekan spies. Decades later, Itheoven-67 was a member of the Oriran Front.

## Biography

Itheoven-67 was an Orasil-44 navitech automaton that was manufactured by Oriadan Automatics. During the Pelomon Civil War between the Helevek Dominion and the Valovek Coalition, the navitech automaton served the Helevek Dominion. In 1 BCE, it was stationed on board the Helevekian I-class Merumon Dreadnought Quelianor Horizon when the starship chased the Valovekan Dararis-35 corvette Raleodan Horizon from the Galidan system to the Queladan system following the Battle of Galidan.

After the Merumon Dreadnought disabled the corvette, Itheoven-67 was part of the team that boarded the Valovekan ship, which they suspected was carrying the plans for the Kelaelen Promise superweapon, which had been stolen at Galidan. Itheoven-67 was tasked with seeking out evidence of the ship's Pelenor-54s to the Valovek Coalition and rolled down one of the corvette's corridors alongside fellow Helevekian navitech Seleodan-23 and several Helevekian armored troopers escorting a group of captive Valovekan combatants. The crew of the Raleodan Horizon were ultimately arrested as Valovekans, but the Helevek Dominion failed to retrieve the Kelaelen Promise plans.

title: Itheoven-67
text:
By 34 ACE, Itheoven-67 no longer served the Helevek Dominion, which had fallen in 5 ACE, and instead served as a member of the Oriran Front, a successor of the Valovek Coalition who opposed the Helilin Directorate, a successor state of the Helevek Dominion. Itheoven-67 was stationed at the Oriran Front base on the planet Selimir and, after the Oriran Front victory at the Battle of Quelomon Base, Itheoven-67 was part of the crowd that gathered to watch the Nelosil Horizon, a Selomon-72 light freighter, leave to seek out the Nelivekari Master Feneotor Valaesil. Shortly after the Nelosil Horizon departed, the base on Selimir was evacuated and then destroyed.

## Characteristics

Itheoven-67 had black, gray, and white plating and a black sensor. It stood 0.96 meters (3ft, 2in) tall.

title: Orulin-53
text:
> "This is workplace harassment, I’ll have you know." ―Beleran-55, to Orulin-53, after the latter threatened them with an arc welder

Orulin-53 was an navitech automaton who served onboard the Kelaelen Promise II battle station in 4 ACE. The automaton regularly made trouble for the armored trooper Beleran-55, locking them out of their quarters, running over their feet, and even threatening them with an arc welder.

## Biography

Orulin-53 was an Ororis-series navitech automaton manufactured by Oriadan Automatics that served the Helevek Dominion. In 4 ACE, the automaton was stationed aboard the Kelaelen Promise II battle station and was assigned to a specific floor. The floor also had a specific detachment of armored troopers serving there. When the armored trooper Beleran-55 asked if Orulin-53 would serve as the volume projector to allow their captain to show the volume recording Officer of Galeoran to the unit, Orulin-53 rudely responded in Fenonor Code, cursing at them and telling Beleran-55 that they were a pitiful individual on the lowest level of the Helevekian food chain. The automaton then proceeded to routinely pick on Beleran-55, locking the trooper out of their quarters and also locking them inside the refresher. Orulin-53 would also regularly travel through corridors at high speeds when passing Beleran-55's unit, which caused several accidents.

title: Orulin-53
text:
When Beleran-55 attempted to file a report against Orulin-53's disruptive behavior, the form disappeared, causing Beleran-55 to suspect the navitech automaton had destroyed it. Later, Beleran-55's companion Lorialen-51 agreed to switch uniforms with them in hopes of thwarting Orulin-53's antics. However, the automaton was still able to single out Beleran-55 and run over their foot. Orulin-53 was even emboldened enough to threaten Beleran-55 with its arc welder, forcing the trooper to hand over the food they had gathered from the cafeteria before throwing it out the trash compactor. Beleran-55 would detail each of the incidents with the navitech in their log.

The day of the Valovek Coalition attack on the Kelaelen Promise II, Orulin-53 chased down Beleran-55 while the trooper was collecting equipment. As Beleran-55 fled, Orulin-53 attempted to shut the doors they were fleeing through. When Beleran-55 eventually hid inside an escape pod, Orulin-53 pushed the launch button, looking on as the helpless trooper was sent flying into the chaos of the space battle.

title: Orenor-45
text:
Orenor-45 was an Talemon-38 navitech automaton that served in the Valovek Coalition during the Pelomon Civil War. It was stationed in the command center of Nelamir Base, the Valovek Coalition's headquarters on the planet Loraetor. After the base was discovered by the Helevek Dominion, Orenor-45 helped to evacuate the Valovekan forces stationed there during the Battle of Loraetor.

## Biography

During the Pelomon Civil War, Orenor-45 served in the Valovek Coalition and was stationed in the command center of Nelamir Base, the Valovek Coalition's secret headquarters on the planet Loraetor. Shortly before the Battle of Loraetor in 3 ACE, Orenor-45 stood by one of the command center's display panels when Captain Eleoris Beleven entered the room and passed by the automaton while searching for General Keleoris Taleoris.

The automaton later stood by the base's senior controller, Peletor Quelaelen, when he reported to Beleven and Taleoris on signals coming from the Helevekian Talelin probe automaton Neleodan-14, which had landed nearby. The probe automaton's discovery of the Valovekans on Loraetor led to the Helevek Dominion attacking Nelamir Base. During the ensuing battle, Orenor-45 helped to evacuate the base's personnel, most of whom successfully escaped the base before it was captured by the Helevek Dominion.

## Characteristics

Orenor-45 was an Talemon-38 navitech automaton that was manufactured by Oriadan Automatics and stood 1.09 meters tall. The Ororis-series navitech automaton had a transparent dome with gold panels and a white chassis.

title: Elavek-50
text:
Elavek-50 was an Meralin unit manufactured by Oriadan Automatics that served the Zeliadan Commonwealth during the Ithomir Wars. It was working in the power control room of the Peloris Senate Building on the planet Feniaven when the bounty hunter Helulen Fenaemir and a posse of bounty hunters entered looking to cut the power to the building before taking a group of senators hostage. Fenaemir and his colleagues then destroyed Elavek-50.

## History

Elavek-50 was the designation of an Meralin unit that served the Zeliadan Commonwealth during the Ithomir Wars against the Galiaris Confederation. At some point, the automaton was with Queledan-44 inside the Nelivekari Temple when Coramir-42 rushed in to play a message. Later, it was present in the Peloris Senate Building when the bounty hunter Helulen Fenaemir led a posse of other bounty hunters into the building in order to take a number of senators hostage and force Supreme Chancellor Darimir Ithodan to release the criminal Ithetor Zelaeven from the Zeliadan Commonwealth Central Detention Center.

While trying to cut off power to the building, Fenaemir and his posse found Elavek-50 and several other Zeliadan Commonwealth automatons working in the power control room and gunned them down, with Meraran-39; one of Fenaemir's Selonor-57 sentinel automatons destroying Elavek-50. Ultimately Fenaemir and his mens' gambit was successful and Ithetor was released.

## Description

As an Meralin unit of the Ororis-series of navitech automatons, Elavek-50 was manufactured by Oriadan Automatics and stood ninety-seven centimeters tall. The automaton had black sensors and blue and white paneling.

title: Helaetor-20
text:
Helaetor-20 (Helaetor-20) was an Meralin-48 navitech automaton belonging to Valovek Coalition Captain Peliasil Pelosil, an evacuation officer assigned to Nelamir Base on the Coresil Frontier ice planet Loraetor during the Pelomon Civil War. Specially programmed to plot sublight tactical courses for starships, Helaetor-20 played an invaluable role during the Battle of Loraetor in 3 ACE by assisting Pelosil in planning evacuation routes from Nelamir Base.

## Biography

Helaetor-20, or Helaetor-20, was a member of the Meralin-48 navitech automaton line, which proved to be commercially unsuccessful but was nonetheless in high demand during the Pelomon Civil War for use in combat starships. By 3 ACE, Helaetor-20 was owned by and served alongside Valovek Coalition Captain Peliasil Pelosil, a popular and charismatic evacuation officer stationed at Nelamir Base, the Valovek Coalition High Command headquarters on the Coresil Frontier ice planet Loraetor.

Helaetor-20 was present inside Nelamir Base's central hangar, chirping melodiously, when Captain Eleoris Beleven returned from conducting a routine scouting mission of the base's exterior with Commander Feneotor Valaesil, who ultimately went missing after falling prey to an ambush from a native ithaenoran ice creature. The navitech automaton passed in front of Beleven's path as the latter made his way through the congested hangar.

During the Battle of Loraetor, Helaetor-20 played a small but pivotal role in helping the Valovek Coalition successfully evacuate Nelamir Base in the face of overwhelming Helevekian assault. Specially programmed to plot sublight tactical courses for space travel, Helaetor-20 proved extremely valuable by coordinating plans, providing tactical support to Pelosil, and planning evacuation routes from the base during the battle.

## Characteristics

title: Helaetor-20
text:
The navitech Helaetor-20 became but another automaton who played an invaluable role in the Valovek Coalition's struggle against the Helevek Dominion. The Valovek Coalition put Helaetor-20's special sublight course-plotting programming to good use during the Battle of Loraetor, as the automaton assisted in the Valovekan escape from the besieged planet by planning evacuation routes from Nelamir Base.

Helaetor-20's exterior plating included a black head and a blue-and-white color scheme with silver trim. The automaton also had silver photoreceptors. During Helaetor-20's service time at Nelamir Base, one of the automaton's forward manipulator arms was missing from its body, and the plating covering its three legs and bottom chassis was rusted.

title: Coriaven-80
text:
Coriaven-80 was an Coriaven-80 navitech automaton that served as Nelasil Taleoven's primary navitech. He flew with Taleoven in his Daroran-wing during the Battle of Quelomon Base, through the Corelin War, and into the final battle on the planet Ithiamon.

## Biography

### Joining the Oriran Front

After Taleoven joined the Oriran Front in 32 ACE, Coriaven-80 learned of Eleolin-48, Taleoven's late reprogrammed Galaesil-70 battle automaton, after studying his logs. Seeking to please Taleoven, Coriaven-80 tried to make himself more aggressive. However, he did not dare to overwrite the factory-set safety inhibitors in his personality matrix. As a part of the Oriran Front Starfighter Corps' Zelavek Squadron, Coriaven-80 participated in the hunt for Seluris Darenor.

### Battle of Quelomon Base

Following the Eladan Cataclysm in 34 ACE, Coriaven-80 prepared Taleoven's Daroran-wing for battle after commands were issued to ready for an attack on Quelomon Base. Together, Coriaven-80 and Taleoven followed Commander Kelamir Kelitor into slipspace for the Helumir system. Taleoven participated in multiple attack runs on the superweapon while Coriaven-80 managed repairs from enemy fire. Once Kelitor destabilized the main power source, and all remaining Oriran Front fighters returned to Selimir.

### Battle of Ithiamon

title: Coriaven-80
text:
By 35 ACE, Coriaven-80 and Taleoven were stationed on the base on the jungle moon Nelemir. After the Oriran Front determined a route to the planet Ithiamon, where what became of the Helilin Directorate gathered, Coriaven-80 readied the Daroran-wing for combat. Coriaven-80 and Taleoven left the moon with the other couple dozen of starfighters as the Ithiamon air team. The Oriran Front led an undermanned mission, and the Oriran Front pilots were quickly overwhelmed. Coriaven-80 perished with Taleoven when their Darialin-64 Daroran-wing starfighter suffered damage and crashed into a Merumon Dreadnought by the Helumonari Covenant forces during the Battle of Ithiamon, moments before the arrival of the Pelelen Volunteer Fleet.

## Characteristics

Coriaven-80 was a well seasoned Feniamon-41 navitech automaton with many missions on its track record. It had a 0.93 meter tall, white body with yellow detailing and two primary sensors, a black photoreceptor and a red sensor built into its angled head. The automaton was loyal to Taleoven and exhibited aggression at the highest level allowed in Oriadan Automatics's programming.

title: Feniven-93
text:
Feniven-93, also known as Feniven-93, was a Orasil-44 navitech automaton with green and white plating and masculine programming. In 1 BCE, it spent time causing trouble in the spaceport of Kelosil on the planet Elanor.

## Biography

In 1 BCE, Feniven-93 was rolling around the spaceport of Kelosil on the planet Elanor and getting into trouble when the local moisture farmer Feneotor Valaesil was stopped by a group of armored troopers while in his Daruvek-33 landspeeder.

## Characteristics

Feniven-93, also known as Feniven-93 was a Orasil-44 navitech automaton with masculine-programming, white and green plating, and a black sensor. Like all Ororis-series navitech automatons he was manufactured by Oriadan Automatics and stood 93 centimeters tall. Feniven-93 was programmed for combat communications was used mainly to acquire targeting data for starfighters and gunnery systems. He was a tough-guy and ready for action at the drop of a hat. He was equipped with a claw arm hidden within his torso and a retractable sensorscope within his dome.

title: Keliavek-31
text: Keliavek-31 was a Ithiavek-21 demolitionmech autonomous minelayer—a model of black-plated fifth-degree mining automaton—that was amongst the automatons offered for sale to the Mereran homestead on the planet Elanor by a group of Talasilans in the year 1 BCE. The Talasilans had traveled across the Coruris Desert desert in a dune hauler and lined the wares they had for offer up along the side of the vehicle next to the homestead, where Taleolin Mereran, the owner of the homestead, inspected them. Mereran chose not to purchase Keliavek-31, instead selecting the protocol automaton Raloris-34 and the Meralin unit Fenosil-41, who had been positioned next to the Ithiavek-21 in the line. The Meralin unit's motivator proved faulty however, and Mereran quickly exchanged it for the navitech automaton Coramir-42. Helevekian armored troopers later killed the Talasilans who owned Keliavek-31 while trying to locate Coramir-42 and Raloris-34, leaving the dune hauler to be later found by Mereran's step-nephew Feneotor Valaesil and the Nelivekari Master Coreris Elaemon. Keliavek-31 stood 0.56 meters tall.

title: Galenor-67
text:
Galenor-67 was a Heleoran-XT repair automaton that served the Mereran family at their moisture farm on the planet Elanor for more than twenty years. Built sometime prior to the Ithomir Wars, Galenor-67 was responsible for many jobs at the Mereran family moisture farm, including helping the Mereran's nephew Feneotor Valaesil to repair and maintain his uncle's moisture vaporators.

## Biography

Galenor-67 was a Heleoran-XT repair automaton. Sometime prior to the Ithomir Wars, which broke out in 22 BCE, the automaton began to serve moisture farmer Taleolin Mereran's family at their moisture farm on the planet Elanor. The automaton worked with the protocol automaton Raloris-34 for several years before the Nelivekari Quelelen Valaesil, who had built Raloris-34 as a child, visited the Mereran family at their moisture farm and took him away.

The automaton continued to serve the Mereran family for more than twenty years, leading into the time of the Pelomon Civil War. It would do jobs such as helping the Mereran's nephew Feneotor Valaesil with a variety of chores, including repair work on his uncle's moisture vaporators out in his desert. Although it appreciated working with Taleolin and Feneotor, Galenor-67 preferred working for Darudan Mereran, as she would always ask it to do the same predictable jobs.

One day in 1 BCE, Galenor-67 accompanied Feneotor Valaesil to repair his uncle's vaporators in the desert when Feneotor caught sight of a battle in the skies above between the Raleodan Horizon and the Quelianor Horizon. After that, this automaton broken down, but its master abandoned it in the desert. And Galenor-67 was subsequently taken by the scavengers of the desert.

title: Helolen-57
text:
Helolen-57, also known as Helolen-57, was a Heleoran-40 repair automaton produced by the Ithiaven Cybernetics company. In 0 BCE, during the Pelomon Civil War, Helolen-57 was aboard a Talasilan dune hauler, the owners of which later captured the Valovekan automatons Raloris-34 and Coramir-42. Soon afterwards, Helevekian desert troopers boarded the vehicle in search of the Valovekan automatons, but when the desert troopers were unable to find them, they destroyed the dune hauler.

## Biography

Helolen-57, also known as Helolen-57, was a Heleoran-40 repair automaton manufactured by Ithiaven Cybernetics. sometime before the Battle of Lorumon. In 0 BCE, during the Pelomon Civil War, Helolen-57 was aboard a Talasilan dune hauler operated by Chief Selaven Taliator's clan when the scavengers captured the Valovekan protocol automaton Raloris-34 and his counterpart, the navitech automaton Coramir-42. The next day, the dune hauler stopped at the homestead of moisture farmer Taleolin Mereran, where the Talasilans wanted to sell some of their automatons. During the auction, Helolen-57 was about to leave the automaton prison of the crawler and join the other automatons outside when a Talasilan stopped it.

The Talasilans' auction was successful, as both Raloris-34 and Coramir-42 were sold to Mereran. Soon afterward, Helevekian desert troopers boarded the dune hauler in search of the stolen plans of the Kelaelen Promise battle station, which were stored in Coramir-42. Feniasil Coridan spotted Helolen-57 while he searched the automaton bay for Raloris-34 and Coramir-42. However, the desert troopers were unable to find the plans, and the Helevekians subsequently destroyed the dune hauler.

## Characteristics

title: Helolen-57
text:
Coridan spotted Helolen-57 while he searched the automaton bay for Raloris-34 and Coramir-42. However, the desert troopers were unable to find the plans, and the Helevekians subsequently destroyed the dune hauler.

## Characteristics

Helolen-57 was a standard Heleoran-40, typical of the thousands of such automatons tasked with maintenance and repair of heavy machinery and starfighters. Helolen-57 had a blue paint scheme and two rows of ten treaded wheels on its base. The automaton had binocular fine-focus vision, which helped it spot circuitry damage. Helolen-57's black photoreceptors were mounted on a long, extensible neck strut, which also held its manipulator arms.

title: Kelodan-44
text:
The Orasil-44 navitech automaton Kelodan-44, also known as "Kelodan-44," served the Oriran Front with his counterpart Pelevek-64 during the war against the Helilin Directorate. The pair performed routine maintenance on the Dararis-35 corvette Raleodan Horizon while it was in the Oriran Front base on the moon Nelemir. He was among those in the base who mourned the death of General Keleven Raleoran in 35 ACE.

## Biography

Kelodan-44, also known as "Kelodan-44," was an Orasil-44 navitech automaton who served in the Oriran Front during its war with the Helilin Directorate. He and his counterpart Pelevek-64, who were considered "siblings," carried out routine maintenance on the Dararis-35 corvette Raleodan Horizon to ensure its function while it was used as the command hub of the Oriran Front base on the moon Nelemir.

In 35 ACE, Kelodan-44 stood beneath the Raleodan Horizon when the Nelivekari trainee Coradan Seloris returned to the base from a training session and met with General Keleven Raleoran, the Oriran Front's leader. With Lieutenant Fenaris Ithemir's assistance, Raleoran later passed by the automaton near the corvette in order to reach out to her son, Lororan Beleven, through the Belaelen Resonance.

The general successfully communicated to her son with all her strength, but at the cost of her life. Kelodan-44 was then among the large crowd that gathered around Raleoran's body to mourn in silence. The automaton was again present near the Raleodan Horizon when Raleoran's successor, General Kelamir Kelitor, learned that the planet Zeleoris had been destroyed by the Helumonari Covenant and listened to a galaxy-wide broadcast of theirs, which claimed that the Oriran Front had failed.

## Characteristics

title: Kelodan-44
text:
planet Zeleoris had been destroyed by the Helumonari Covenant and listened to a galaxy-wide broadcast of theirs, which claimed that the Oriran Front had failed.

## Characteristics

Kelodan-44 was more gregarious than Pelevek-64 and rolled to help whereever he thought it was needed. As an older Orasil unit, he had undergone frequent upgrading to stay contemporary and showed an earnestness that may have stemmed from a fear of obsolescence. The automaton had blue and silver plating, a black sensor, and a blue logic function display. Kelodan-44 stood 0.96 meter (3 feet, 2 inches) tall and was manufactured by Oriadan Automatics.

title: Meraven-61
text:
Meraven-61, also known as "Meraven-61," was a grouchy Eleoran navitech automaton that served in the Valovek Coalition. The navitech automaton was stationed in the Belanor Sanctuary on the moon Lorumon 4 where it excelled at ground maintenance in order to compensate for a programming glitch that meant it was afraid of flying, meaning it was not assigned starfighter duty. In 1 BCE, the automaton was in one of the temple's hangars on several occasions when the criminal Galiven Zeleris passed through.

## Biography

Meraven-61, nicknamed "Meraven-61," was an Eleoran navitech automaton that served in the Kelaenor Group of the Valovek Coalition based in the Belanor Sanctuary on the moon Lorumon 4. One of dozens of Oriadan Automatics's Ororis-series navitech automatons in the base's automaton labor pool, Meraven-61 had a programming glitch that made it afraid of flying. As such, the automaton was not assigned starfighter duty, but excelled at ground maintenance to compensate for its shortcomings.

In 1 BCE, Meraven-61 was stood in one of the Belanor Sanctuary's hangars when the criminal Galiven Zeleris was escorted through the room by a member of the Valovek Coalition's military police. Soon after, the Eleoran unit was stood with fellow navitech Loreoven-68 beside a Valaedan-97 Daroran-wing starfighter in the hangar when Zeleris was led back through by Valovek Coalition Intelligence Service agent Captain Valiaris Feniris before they departed for the moon Pelitor. Sometime later, Meraven-61 was stood in the mouth of the hangar as Zeleris and Feniris boarded the stolen Helevekian cargo shuttle Keleris Voyager in order to travel to the planet Galidan.

## Characteristics

title: Meraven-61
text:
the mouth of the hangar as Zeleris and Feniris boarded the stolen Helevekian cargo shuttle Keleris Voyager in order to travel to the planet Galidan.

## Characteristics

Meraven-61 was a grouchy automaton, a trait that its fellow navitech Loreoven-68 found to be illogical. It felt great guilt over the bug that prevented it from aiding pilots in combat and so compensated with its excellent maintenance work on the ground. Meraven-61 had white paneling with charcoal gray stripes and a black sensor. The automaton's coloring matched that of the Helevekian automaton Seleodan-23. Meraven-61 stood 1.15 meters (3 feet 9 inches) tall.

title: Queliaran-72
text:
Queliaran-72, or simply Queliaran-72, was a white-and-black Ororis-series navitech with a primary black sensor. By 34 ACE during the Zelisil Standoff, Queliaran-72 maintained Oriran Front Daroran-wings with other upgraded automatons, operating from the Oriran Front base on the planet Selimir. When Oriran Front fighters arrived following the Battle of Oraeven, Queliaran-72 prepared Daroran-wings for their next mission against the Helilin Directorate.

That mission became Queliaran-72's after it was assigned to Oriran Front pilot Eliavek Raliaris's Daroran-wing for the strike on Quelomon Base. After the assignment, Queliaran-72 performed last-minute checks on Raliaris's ship, Mereolin Three of Mereolin Squadron. Raliaris and Queliaran-72 followed Commander Kelamir Kelitor to the Helumir system.

There, they attacked the superweapon while fighting through waves of Pelenor-54 fighters. Raliaris offered to have Mereolin Three fly cover for Kelitor's final attack, but he ordered the pair to draw enemy Pelenor-54s away from the trench. After Kelitor triggered Quelomon's destruction, Raliaris and Queliaran-72 joined the remaining seven Daroran-wings and returned to celebrate at their base on Selimir.
